Saari taareef us Allah ke liye hai jis ke ikhtiyaar mein aasmaan aur zameen ki tamaam cheezein hain, aur usi ke liye aakhirat mein bhi hamd hai, aur wahi saahib-e-hikmat aur har baat ki khabar rakhne waala hai

Woh jaanta hai ke zameen mein kya cheez daakhil hoti hai aur kya cheez us se nikalti hai, aur kya cheez aasmaan se naazil hoti hai aur kya us mein buland hoti hai, aur woh meharbaan aur bakhshne waala hai

Aur kuffaar kehte hain ke qiyaamat aane waali nahin hai. To aap keh dijiye ke mere Parwardigar ki qasam! Woh zaroor aaegi. Woh Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai, us ke ilm se aasmaan o zameen ka koi zarra door nahin hai, aur na us se chhota aur na bada, balke sab kuch us ki raushan kitaab mein mahfooz hai
Taake woh imaan laane waale aur nek aamaal anjaam dene waalon ko jaza de, ke un ke liye maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq hai
Aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaton ke muqaable mein daud-dhoop ki un ke liye dardnaak saza ka azaab mu'ayyan hai

Aur jin logon ko ilm diya gaya hai woh jaante hain ke jo kuch aap ki taraf Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai sab bilkul haq hai, aur Khuda-e-Ghaalib o qaabil-e-hamd o sana ki taraf hidaayat karne waala hai

Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un ka kehna hai ke hum tumhein aise aadmi ka pata batayein jo yeh khabar deta hai ke jab tum marne ke baad tukde tukde ho jaaoge to tumhein nayi khilqat ke bhes mein laaya jaaega
Us ne Allah par jhoota ilzaam baandha hai ya us mein junoon paaya jaata hai? Nahin, balke jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte woh azaab aur gumraahi mein mubtala hain

Kya unhon ne aasmaan o zameen mein apne saamne aur pas-e-pusht ki cheezon ko nahin dekha hai? Ke hum chaahein to inhein zameen mein dhansa dein ya un ke oopar aasmaan ko tukde tukde kar ke gira dein. Is mein har rujoo karne waale bande ke liye qudrat ki nishaani paayi jaati hai
Aur hum ne Dawood ko yeh fazl ata kiya ke pahaado! Tum un ke saath tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar kiya karo, aur parindon ko musakhkhar kar diya, aur lohe ko narm kar diya
Ke tum kushaada aur mukammal zirahein banaao aur kadiyon ke jodne mein andaaze ka khayaal rakho, aur tum log sab nek amal karo ke main tum sab ke aamaal ka dekhne waala hoon

Aur hum ne Sulaimaan alaihis-salaam ke saath hawaaon ko musakhkhar kar diya ke un ki subah ki raftaar ek maah ki masaafat thi aur shaam ki raftaar bhi ek maah ke baraabar thi, aur hum ne un ke liye taanbe ka chashma jaari kar diya, aur jinnaat mein aise afraad bana diye jo Khuda ki ijaazat se un ke saamne kaam karte the, aur jis ne hamaare hukm se inhiraaf kiya hum use aatish-e-Jahannam ka maza chakhaayenge

Yeh jinnaat Sulaimaan ke liye jo woh chaahte the bana dete the, jaise mehraabein, tasveerein, aur hauzon ke baraabar pyaale, aur badi badi zameen mein gadi hui degein. Aal-e-Dawood! Shukr ada karo, aur hamaare bandon mein shukr-guzaar bande bahut kam hain

Phir jab hum ne un ki maut ka faisla kar diya to un ki maut ki khabar bhi jinnaat ko kisi ne na bataayi siwaaye deemak ke jo un ke asa ko kha rahi thi. Aur woh khaak par gire to jinnaat ko maaloom hua ke agar woh ghaib ke jaanne waale hote to is zaleel karne waale azaab mein mubtala na rehte

Aur qaum-e-Saba ke liye un ke watan hi mein hamaari nishaani thi ke daahine baayein dono taraf baaghaat the. Tum log apne Parwardigar ka diya rizq khaao aur us ka shukr ada karo, tumhaare liye paakeeza shehar aur bakhshne waala Parwardigar hai

Magar un logon ne inhiraaf kiya to hum ne un par bade zoron ka sailaab bhej diya, aur un ke dono baaghaat ko aise do baaghaat mein tabdeel kar diya jin ke phal be-maza the, aur un mein jhaao ke darakht aur kuch beriyaan bhi thin
Yeh hum ne un ki naashukri ki saza di hai, aur hum naashukron ke ilaawa kis ko saza dete hain

Aur jab hum ne un ke aur un bastiyon ke darmiyaan jin mein hum ne barakatein rakhi hain kuch numaayaan bastiyaan qaraar deen aur un ke darmiyaan sair ko mu'ayyan kar diya ke ab din o raat jab chaaho safar karo, mahfooz rahoge

To unhon ne is par bhi yeh kaha ke Parwardigar! Hamaare safar door-daraaz bana de, aur is tarah apne nafs par zulm kiya. To hum ne inhein kahaani bana kar chhod diya aur inhein tukde tukde kar diya, ke yaqeenan is mein sabr o shukr karne waalon ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur un par Iblees ne apne gumaan ko sachcha kar dikhaaya, to momineen ke ek giroh ko chhod kar sab ne us ka ittibaa' kar liya

Aur Shaitaan ko un par ikhtiyaar haasil na hota, magar hum yeh jaanna chaahte hain ke kaun aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai aur kaun us ki taraf se shak mein mubtala hai, aur aap ka Parwardigar har shai ka nigraan hai

Aap keh dijiye ke tum log unhein pukaaro jin ka Allah ko chhod kar tumhein khayaal tha, to dekhoge ke yeh aasmaan o zameen mein ek zarra baraabar ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte hain, aur na un ka aasmaan o zameen mein koi hissa hai, aur na un mein se koi un logon ka pusht-panaah hai

Us ke yahaan kisi ki sifaarish bhi kaam aane waali nahin hai magar woh jis ko woh khud ijaazat de de. Yahaan tak ke jab un ke dilon ki haibat door kar di jaaegi to poochhenge ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne kya kaha hai? To woh jawaab denge ke jo kuch kaha hai haq kaha hai, aur woh buland o baala aur buzurg o bartar hai
Aap kahiye ke tumhein aasmaan o zameen se rozi kaun deta hai, aur phir bataaiye ke Allah. Aur kahiye ke hum ya tum hidaayat par hain ya khuli hui gumraahi mein hain
Inhein bataaiye ke hum jo khata karenge us ke baare mein tum se sawaal na kiya jaaega, aur tum jo kuch karoge us ke baare mein hum se sawaal na hoga
Kahiye ke ek din Khuda hum sab ko jama karega aur phir hamaare darmiyaan haq ke saath faisla karega, aur woh behtareen faisla karne waala hai aur jaanne waala hai
Un se kahiye ke zara un shuraka ko dikhlaao jin ko Khuda se mila diya hai. Yeh hargiz nahin dikha sakenge, balke Khuda sirf Khuda-e-Azeez o Hakeem hai
Aur Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko tamaam logon ke liye sirf basheer o nazeer bana kar bheja hai, yeh aur baat hai ke aksar log is haqeeqat se baakhabar nahin hain
Aur kehte hain ke agar tum sachche ho to yeh waada-e-qiyaamat kab poora hoga
Keh dijiye ke tumhaare liye ek din ka waada muqarrar hai jis se na ek saa'at peechhe hat sakte ho aur na aage badh sakte ho

Aur kuffaar yeh kehte hain ke hum na is Quran par imaan laayenge aur na is se pehle waali kitaabon par. To kaash aap dekhte jab in zaalimon ko Parwardigar ke huzoor khada kiya jaaega aur har ek baat ko doosre ki taraf palataaega. Aur jin logon ko kamzor samajh liya gaya hai woh oonche ban jaane waalon se kahenge ke agar tum darmiyaan mein na aa gaye hote to hum saahib-e-imaan ho gaye hote
To bade log kamzor logon se kahenge ke kya hum ne tumhein hidaayat ke aane ke baad us ke qubool karne se roka tha? Hargiz nahin, tum khud mujrim the

Aur kamzor log bade logon se kahenge ke yeh tumhaari din raat ki makkaari ka asar hai, jab tum humein hukm dete the ke Khuda ka inkaar karein aur us ke liye misl qaraar dein. Aur azaab dekhne ke baad log apne dil hi dil mein sharminda bhi honge, aur hum kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ki gardan mein tauq bhi daal denge. Kya un ko us ke ilaawa koi badla diya jaaega jo aamaal yeh karte rahe hain
Aur hum ne kisi basti mein koi daraane waala nahin bheja magar yeh ke us ke bade logon ne yeh keh diya ke hum tumhaare paighaam ka inkaar karne waale hain
Aur yeh bhi keh diya ke hum amwaal aur aulaad ke etibaar se tum se behtar hain aur hum par azaab hone waala nahin hai
Aap keh dijiye ke mera Parwardigar jis ke rizq mein chaahta hai kami ya zyaadati kar deta hai, lekin aksar log nahin jaante hain

Aur tumhaare amwaal aur aulaad mein koi aisa nahin hai jo tumhein hamaari baargaah mein qareeb bana sake, ilaawa un ke jo imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye, to un ke liye un ke aamaal ka dohra badla diya jaaega aur woh jharokon mein amn o amaan ke saath baithe honge
Aur jo log hamaari nishaaniyon ke muqaable mein daud-dhoop kar rahe hain woh Jahannam ke azaab mein jhonk diye jaayenge

Beshak hamaara Parwardigar apne bandon mein jis ke rizq mein chaahta hai wus'at paida karta hai aur jis ke rizq mein chaahta hai tangi paida karta hai, aur jo kuch us ki raah mein kharch karoge woh us ka badla bahar-haal ata karega, aur woh behtareen rizq dene waala hai
Aur jis din Khuda sab ko jama karega aur phir malaaika se kahega ke kya yeh log tumhaari hi ibaadat karte the
To woh arz karenge ke tu paak o be-niyaaz aur hamaara Wali hai, yeh hamaare kuch nahin hain, aur yeh jinnaat ki ibaadat karte the aur un ki aksariyat unhi par imaan rakhti thi
Phir aaj koi kisi ke nafa aur nuqsaan ka maalik nahin hoga, aur hum zulm karne waalon se kahenge ke us Jahannam ke azaab ka maza chakho jis ki takzeeb kiya karte the

Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari raushan aayaton ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to kehte hain ke yeh shakhs sirf yeh chaahta hai ke tumhein un sab se rok de jin ki tumhaare aaba o ajdaad parastish kiya karte the, aur yeh sirf ek gadhi hui daastaan hai. Aur kuffaar to jab bhi un ke saamne haq aata hai yahi kehte hain ke yeh ek khula hua jaadoo hai
Aur hum ne inhein aisi kitaabein nahin ata ki hain jinhein yeh padhte hon, aur na un ki taraf aap se pehle koi daraane waala bheja hai

Aur un ke pehle waalon ne bhi anbiya ki takzeeb ki hai, haalaanke un ke paas us ka daswaan hissa bhi nahin hai jitna hum ne un logon ko ata kiya tha, magar unhon ne bhi rasoolon ki takzeeb ki to tum ne dekha ke hamaara azaab kitna bhayaanak tha

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke main tumhein sirf is baat ki naseehat karta hoon ke Allah ke liye ek ek do do kar ke utho aur phir yeh ghaur karo ke tumhaare saathi mein kisi tarah ka junoon nahin hai. Woh sirf aane waale shadeed azaab ke pesh aane se pehle tumhaara daraane waala hai
Keh dijiye ke main jo ajr maang raha hoon woh bhi tumhaare hi liye hai, mera haqeeqi ajr to Parwardigar ke zimme hai, aur woh har shai ka gawaah hai
Keh dijiye ke mera Parwardigar haq ko baraabar dil mein daalta rehta hai, aur woh baraabar ghaib ka jaanne waala hai
Aap keh dijiye ke haq aa gaya hai, aur baatil na kuch eejaad kar sakta hai aur na dobaara palta sakta hai
Keh dijiye ke main gumraah hoonga to us ka asar mere hi oopar hoga, aur agar hidaayat haasil kar loonga to yeh mere Rab ki wahi ka nateeja hoga, woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab se qareeb-tar hai
Aur kaash aap dekhte ke yeh ghabraaye hue honge aur bach na sakenge, aur bahut qareeb se pakad liye jaayenge
Aur woh kahenge ke hum imaan le aaye, haalaanke itni door-daraaz jagah se imaan tak dastaras kahaan mumkin hai
Aur yeh pehle inkaar kar chuke hain, aur az-ghaib baatein bahut door tak chalaate rahe hain

Aur ab to un ke aur un cheezon ke darmiyaan jin ki yeh khwaahish rakhte hain parde haail kar diye gaye hain, jis tarah un ke pehle waalon ke saath kiya gaya tha, ke woh log bhi bade bechain karne waale shak mein pade hue the
